**Record** in the `Latiprimere` namespace, from the [Latiprimere.Abstractions](/docs/reference/#latiprimereabstractions) package.

```csharp
public sealed record MediaType
```

A kind of paper or other medium to print on, such as plain paper, labels or glossy photo paper, as the printer reports it.

## Constructors

```csharp
public MediaType()
```

## Properties

### Id

```csharp
public required string Id { get; init; }
```

Gets the identifier to pass back in [PrintOptions.MediaType](/docs/reference/latiprimere-abstractions/printoptions/#mediatype): an IPP `media-type` keyword, such as `stationery` or `labels`, or a Windows driver's number for the type. It only means something to the printer that reported it.

### Name

```csharp
public required string Name { get; init; }
```

Gets the name to show people, such as "Labels".
